# SVG to Slides

> Free Chrome extension (plus web uploader and Google Slides add-on) that inserts SVG files into Google Slides as native, editable shapes. Free forever. Every feature, no daily cap, no account, no Pro tier.

Google Slides doesn't keep SVG files as editable vectors. SVG to Slides converts every SVG path into its own native Slides shape, so users can recolor individual elements, edit points, animate shapes, and resize without losing quality. The shapes also work in Google Drawings.

- Install (Chrome Web Store): https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/svg-to-slides/bdhhnakellmdnbgbdokiojipaebdeioi
- Web uploader, no install: https://svgslid.es/convert

## Docs
- [Overview](https://svgslid.es/index.md): what it does, how it works, limits
- [Guides index](https://svgslid.es/guides.md)
- [SVG vs PNG in Google Slides](https://svgslid.es/guides/svg-vs-png-google-slides.md): When Google Slides flattens an SVG it becomes a single image that blurs when resized and can't be recoloured or edited. SVG to Slides converts every path into Slides' own native shape format instead, so the result behaves like a shape you drew yourself.
- [Insert an SVG into Google Slides](https://svgslid.es/guides/insert-svg-into-google-slides.md): Google Slides doesn't support SVG files, so you can't upload one as an editable graphic. To insert an SVG into Google Slides, install the free SVG to Slides Chrome extension, open your presentation, and drag the .svg file onto a slide. Each path becomes its own native Slides shape.
- [Does Google Slides support SVG?](https://svgslid.es/guides/does-google-slides-support-svg.md): No. Google Slides doesn't keep SVG files as editable vectors. Your options are to flatten the SVG into a PNG, or convert it through EMF and Google Drawings. SVG to Slides converts the file into Slides' native shape format, so it stays editable.
- [SVG to Google Slides converter](https://svgslid.es/guides/svg-to-google-slides-converter.md): SVG to Slides converts SVG files into native, editable Google Slides shapes. Use the Chrome extension to drop files straight onto a slide, or the web converter to turn a batch of SVGs into a Slides-ready file in Google Drive. Every surface is free.
- [Edit & recolor SVGs in Google Slides](https://svgslid.es/guides/recolor-svg-in-google-slides.md): Once converted with SVG to Slides, every path in your SVG is a separate native Slides shape. Select one element and change its fill with the standard picker, edit its points, or animate it on its own.
- [SVG logos & icons in Slides themes](https://svgslid.es/guides/svg-logos-icons-google-slides.md): Convert your logo or icon set with SVG to Slides, add it to your theme layouts, and reuse it on every slide. The shapes resize without losing quality and also work in Google Drawings.
- [Web uploader](https://svgslid.es/convert.md): upload SVGs, get a Slides-ready Drive file
- [Google Slides add-on](https://svgslid.es/google-slides-addon.md): insert SVGs from a dialog inside Slides

## Blog
- [Product screenshots go stale. Native UI mockups don't.](https://svgslid.es/blog/native-ui-mockups-google-slides.md): Every release breaks the screenshots in your decks. Build simplified product UI as native shapes and live text instead, kept in one library deck, and a renamed button is a find and replace.
- [Run a messaging workshop in Google Forms and build a brand style sheet in Google Sheets](https://svgslid.es/blog/messaging-workshop-brand-style-sheet-google-sheets.md): A form collects the answers. One sheet turns them into messaging. A second sheet holds the brand's colours, type and voice in a form scripts and Gems can read.
- [Update Google Slides collateral from one messaging sheet with Gemini](https://svgslid.es/blog/google-slides-collateral-messaging-sheet-gemini.md): Write the brief once in a sheet. Gemini writes each line to a recipe and a character limit, and a script puts it in every one-pager, brief, whitepaper and battlecard.
- [Google Slides finally does letter spacing](https://svgslid.es/blog/letter-spacing-google-slides.md): Tracking has landed in Slides. Here's what it is, how to use it well, and why Docs looks next.
- [Audit what Gemini's whole-deck edit changed](https://svgslid.es/blog/audit-gemini-whole-deck-edits-google-slides.md): Gemini can now edit an entire presentation from one prompt. It tells you what it changed. Here is how to check, object by object, with a snapshot before and a diff after.
- [A competitor matrix where every cell cites its source](https://svgslid.es/blog/competitor-matrix-google-sheets-gemini-citations.md): AI-filled competitive research was unusable because nobody could check it. As of this week, Fill with Gemini attaches a web source to each cell. Build the matrix around that.
- [On-brand charts in Slides, from Sheets data to native shapes](https://svgslid.es/blog/on-brand-charts-google-slides.md): Sheets keeps adding chart types. None of them look like your brand once they're in a deck. Draw the chart as shapes instead, and every bar takes your colours and type.
- [Workspace Studio won't run on shared files. Design around it.](https://svgslid.es/blog/workspace-studio-shared-files-messaging-flow.md): Studio flows fail on shared drives, shared folders and IMPORTRANGE. Messaging sheets are shared by definition. Here is the two-sheet pattern that works.
- [Turn your messaging recipes into Gemini skills](https://svgslid.es/blog/gemini-skills-messaging-recipes.md): Skills are replacing Gems as the way to give Gemini standing instructions. Write your copy rules once and call them with @ in Docs, Slides and Gmail.
- [Customer proof points expire. Track them.](https://svgslid.es/blog/customer-proof-points-expiry-google-sheets.md): Logos, quotes and case studies come with permission, and permission has an end date. Keep a proof library in Sheets and get warned before a quote goes stale.
- [Find which slide draws the objections](https://svgslid.es/blog/google-meet-notes-screenshots-slide-objections.md): Meet notes now capture the slide on screen. Log each objection against that slide and the weak spots in your deck show up in a week.
- [Certify reps on the new message with a Forms quiz](https://svgslid.es/blog/sales-enablement-quiz-google-forms.md): A launch isn't landed until the people selling it can say it. Build a short quiz from the messaging, score it in Sheets, and follow up with whoever missed.
- [Localize a one-pager without breaking the layout](https://svgslid.es/blog/localize-one-pager-google-slides.md): Translations run long. Give every slot a budget per language, draft in Sheets, and catch the overflow before it reaches the page.
